exposure: Semaphorin 3F level in venous umbilical blood
cohort: Pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean section or amniocentesis
finding: Semaphorin 3F levels in maternal serum, amniotic fluid, and venous umbilical blood were significantly lower in women with preeclampsia compared to those without, suggesting potential as a predictive biomarker.
gest_age: 16-18 weeks at amniocentesis, delivery for cesarean section group
